title: ConversationOwner
description: Who owns a conversation, in the kubemoot_conversations bucket, key own.<namespace>.<crew>.<conversationId>. The discussion gateway writes it when it accepts the first question of a conversation on a crew that verifies callers, and rewrites it with every later question so it lives exactly as long as the conversation's history. It holds the principal's pseudonymous id only, never a subject or a token. A conversation with no record is owned by no one: only an operator may read it.

owner.description: The principal that started the conversation. An anonymous owner is the anonymous caller of a crew that accepts them.
